feeds.title: Sage Goddess Blog
feeds.description: Delve into the realms of ancient and contemporary magic with Dr. Athena Perrakis, Founder and CEO of Sage Goddess. Explore crystal energy, financial prosperity, gratitude, and chakra alignment through insightful blog posts. Embark on a spiritual journey enriched with sacred tools and metaphysical wisdom.

feeds.title: Spiritual Arts Institute Blog
feeds.description: Explore contemplative prayers, metaphysics, and soul evolution on Spiritual Arts Institute's blog. Founded by Barbara Y. Martin and Dimitri Moraitis, it's a leading metaphysical school based in Encinitas, CA, fostering global spiritual growth through its online community.

feeds.title: Divine Openings Blog
feeds.description: Discover insights into spiritual enlightenment on Lola Jones' blog, Divine Openings. Lola, a renowned teacher and healing expert, offers practical life solutions for spiritual bliss. Assisted by a dedicated team, Lola creates books, audio, art, videos, and courses to share the essence of Divine Openings.

feeds.title: Center for Spiritual Living Tucson Blog
feeds.description: The Center for Spiritual Living Tucson fosters spiritual growth and community, promoting acceptance, love, and peace. Through meditation, classes, and affirmative prayer, they empower individuals to explore and discover spiritual solutions to life's challenges, fostering abundance and joy.

feeds.title: Stillpoint Blog
feeds.description: Stillpoint provides pathways to wholeness through contemplative living, faithful practice, and spiritual activism. Their programs form spiritual directors grounded in contemplation and action, offering spaces for spiritual practices and connections to sustain soulful journeys.

feeds.title: iChakras Blog
feeds.description: D. Krystal Starr, founder of IChakras, demystifies the healing journey by providing clear and accessible guidance. With groundbreaking insights, IChakras offers a tangible path to healing and meditation, leading individuals to embrace energy and experience complete healing of mind, body, and soul.

feeds.title: Dr. Priscilla Stuckey
feeds.description: Dr Priscilla Stuckey, a writer and spiritual counsellor, seeks to transform the modern narrative of nature and facilitate reconnection with the Living Source within oneself and nature. With a Ph.D. in religious studies, she's taught environmental humanities and critical thinking. Explore her latest posts on everyday nature spirituality for a journey of sensory and spiritual reconnection with the Earth.

feeds.title: Sondra Sula's Blog: The Nature of Spirituality
feeds.description: Sondra Sula, an author, artist, and Quaker mystic, channels her profound spirituality into various disciplines, resulting in multiple published books, including children's literature and contributions to anthologies.

feeds.title: Centers for Spiritual Living Fullerton Blog
feeds.description: The Centers for Spiritual Living Blog, founded by Dr Ernest Holmes, fosters a loving spiritual community dedicated to empowering individuals to lead healthy and successful lives by practising the Principles of the Science of Mind.

feeds.title: Spirituality for Kids Blog
feeds.description: At Spirituality for Kids, every child's spirit is cherished. Their mission is to instil resilience, self-awareness, and compassion, guiding children to trust their intuition. Their resources offer inspiration and practical tips for developing spiritual and emotional intelligence for the whole family. Join their mailing list for insightful articles and news.

feeds.title: Spiritual Gangster Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2008 by yoga instructors Vanessa Lee and Ian Lopatin, Spiritual Gangster evolved from a studio brand to a global phenomenon. It embodies a lifestyle inspired by high-vibration living, fostering a community fueled by wellness, love, positivity, and joy. Explore their blog for stories and horoscopes.

feeds.title: Ratna Ling Retreats Blog
feeds.description: Ratna Ling Retreat Center, guided by Tibetan Buddhist traditions, offers education, healing, and spirituality for everyday life integration. With a mission to share the best of human existence, they serve humanity by leading others toward wholeness and wellness on the path of Enlightenment. Resident volunteers practice embodying sacred wholeness and wellness as guardians and examples for all.

feeds.title: Herst Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Herst Wellness offers personalized coaching integrating mind, body, and spirit to illuminate every aspect of life. With a blend of one-on-one coaching and mindfulness training, they empower individuals to overcome obstacles, foster ease, and enhance relationships. Herst Wellness fosters holistic well-being, helping individuals achieve harmony between work, life, and spirit for a fulfilling existence.

feeds.title: Davidya.ca Blog
feeds.description: David 'Davidya' Buckland's exploration on Davidya.ca delves into life and enlightenment, focusing on post-personal stages of development and the journey towards enlightenment. Through articles and podcasts, Davidya provides valuable insights, inviting subscribers to join the conversation and receive the latest updates.

feeds.title: Path & Purpose Blog
feeds.description: Dr Cameron Martin, through Path and Purpose Blog, offers support for spiritually-awakening individuals, guiding them to discover their soul's purpose and live in alignment with their Higher Self. With articles covering astrology, consciousness, soul growth, and more, the blog serves as a comprehensive resource for spiritual development and self-discovery.

feeds.title: Kim Burris Blog
feeds.description: Meet Kim Burris, a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist in California, who offers holistic psychotherapy with an evidence-based, heart-centred approach. Specializing in anxiety, childhood wounds, postpartum depression, and spirituality, Kim helps clients fear less, love more, and create fulfilling lives. Explore her mental health blog for inspiration and resources on holistic transformation, healing anxiety, supporting new moms, and understanding the link between spirituality and mental health.

feeds.title: Galactic Federation of Light » Alternative Healing
feeds.description: The Galactic Federation of Light (GFL), founded in 2020 by Dotan Shoham and his daughters, Shani and Tevelle, is a visionary clothing brand based in Los Angeles. With a mission to unite Light Workers and spread positivity, GFL offers high-vibration apparel, fostering a community of like-minded individuals dedicated to truth, love, and illumination.

feeds.title: Spirituality & Practice Blog
feeds.description: Since its launch in 2006, Spirituality and Practice has united the lifelong efforts of co-directors Frederic and Mary Ann Brussat. With contributions from a dedicated team, the site offers diverse resources for spiritual exploration, reflecting a commitment to multifaith and inter-spiritual perspectives.
